meta.name: chat
meta.description: Context-aware chat about the project: discuss plans, retros, lessons, and code; navigate the vault; and handle chores (frontmatter tweaks, status flips, inline plan or code edits) without invoking the heavier skills. Opens every session with a vault status summary.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自然语言讨论项目、处理杂务和浏览知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望在日常工作中用对话快速处理项目事务
copy.tagline_en: Discuss projects, handle chores, and navigate the vault with natural language
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to handle project tasks and navigate your knowledge base through conversation

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以讨论项目计划、回顾、经验教训和代码，浏览项目文件，处理轻量任务（如修改文件头部信息、更新状态、编辑计划或代码），并在每次对话开始时自动总结项目状态。
howto.when: 当你想讨论项目相关内容或执行简单文件操作时触发，无需调用更复杂的技能。

say.text: 帮我看看这个项目的当前状态。
把这篇笔记的状态改为“已完成”。
say.note: Claude 会修改文件头部信息。

say.text: 讨论一下我们上周的回顾。
say.note: Claude 会基于项目文件进行讨论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can discuss project plans, retros, lessons, and code; navigate the vault; and handle chores like frontmatter tweaks, status flips, inline plan or code edits. It opens every session with a vault status summary.
howto.when_en: When you want to discuss project-related topics or perform simple file operations, without invoking heavier skills.

say_en.text: Show me the current status of the project.
say_en.note: Claude will summarize the vault status.

say_en.text: Change the status of this note to 'completed'.

say_en.note: Claude will discuss based on project files.
